### Highlights

- Switch every display at once: a new "All displays" bar at the top of the switch center switches every shared display to the host you pick, one after another. A sleeping host is woken by the first switch. When every display is on one host, that host shows "All showing".
- Input notes: on the Displays & Hosts page you can add a note to any input of a shared display, such as naming "Input 8" as "USB-C". Notes appear as "USB-C (Input 8)" on host cards, input menus, switch results and the host switcher, and sync to every paired host.

### Fixes

- Fixed a shared display being removed from the shared list, along with other hosts' input settings, when this computer could no longer detect it after switching to another host (many displays drop inactive connections). It now shows as showing another host.
- Fixed the host switcher showing the wrong port names for displays that only report input numbers, such as the MSI MPG 274U.

### Known limitations

- Input notes only sync between hosts running this version; older hosts ignore the notes.
- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed but not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may require manual approval.
